answer: The ledger that matters is Vat cooper pine cask seal entered in the keg store book: each pine cask is a measured barrel yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must, written by clerks who never met the applicant. One honest agent risks 116 POA once; a farm of 404 risks 46864 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. A marble that lapses, a thread that recurs, and a river that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
